limitations: Only frozen tiny-field scope; no NFS or ECDLP complexity claim.
Baseline truth and planted scalars never enter paired relation solving.
Incomplete rank and descent coverage remain explicit.
A successful internal checker is not independent review.

arm_accounting.interpretation: Components are references, not summed totals. Each pairing cold start pays its own fresh setup plus the shared admission dependency. Reused-power arm pays its own direct base/target pairings before powers. Baseline solver arms start from obtained public images; acquisition and basis conversion are named separately. Parent pairings phase is an inclusive diagnostic and excludes child-arm primitive counts; never add it to child-arm times. No per-arm or end-to-end advantage claimed.

work_accounting.convention: Named primitive calls and attempts; arithmetic layers overlap. Main counter excludes separately recorded fresh-arm counters. Phase allocations are leaf-exclusive, phase times inclusive; never sum layers or inclusive times.

resource.scope: trial through result assembly before artifact serialization; RUSAGE_SELF lifetime high-water includes imports and prior phases; excludes child processes; not incremental or per-arm

unpriced_work: Python allocation/serialization and comparisons except explicitly counted comparisons
checker replay wall/CPU and lifetime RSS reported separately on --check stdout, not trial counters
